title: Amendment to Rule 2(5)(c) - Plots up to 500 sq m
warning_text_en: AMENDMENT WARNING (28 Aug 2026): Under the amendment to Rule 2(5)(c) of the MP Bhumi Vikas Rules 2012, construction/reconstruction on plots up to 500 sq. metres that conforms to the approved Development Plan does NOT require separate development permission under Rule 2(5)(a); building permission may be granted directly by the local authority.
warning_text_hi: संशोधन चेतावनी (28 अगस्त 2026): म.प्र. भूमि विकास नियम 2012 के नियम 2(5)(ग) में 28 अगस्त 2026 के संशोधन अनुसार, स्वीकृत विकास योजना (Development Plan) के अनुरूप 500 वर्ग मीटर तक के भूखंडों पर निर्माण/पुनर्निर्माण हेतु नियम 2(5)(क) के तहत अलग से विकास अनुमति (Development Permission) की आवश्यकता नहीं है; स्थानीय निकाय द्वारा सीधे भवन निर्माण अनुमति दी जा सकती है।
details: The Government of Madhya Pradesh, on August 28, 2026, amended Rule 2(5)(c) of the Madhya Pradesh Bhumi Vikas Rules, 2012 concerning construction and reconstruction of buildings on smaller plots. Under the substituted provision, where the proposed construction/reconstruction is in conformity with the existing land use specified in the approved Development Plan of the town, the local authority may permit construction or reconstruction on plots having an area of up to 500 sq. metres, subject to compliance with the norms of the applicable Development Plan. The key change is that such construction/reconstruction on plots up to 500 sq. metres will not require separate development permission under Rule 2(5)(a).
